plugins.name: gtm-skills
plugins.description: For B2B founders, CMOs and product marketers: decide which go-to-market motion should lead (product-led, sales-led, partner or community), which category to own and what your core message is. Give it your product, buyers, stage and market; get the four motions scored, a positioning and message hierarchy, and vague AI prompts made specific. Built on Helix's IMPACT, EPIC and CRAFT methods.
